title: PickaxeDrill
description: Adds a powerful Netherite Drill that mines a 3x3 area with particles and configurable crafting.
body:
# ⛏️ PickaxeDrill
## 3x3 Mining Tool

---

## 🔥 Overview

PickaxeDrill adds a powerful **Netherite Drill** that mines in a **3x3 area**.

---

## ✨ Features

### ⛏️ 3x3 Mining
- Breaks a 3x3 area in front of the player  

### 🟣 Particles
- Purple particle effects when mining  

### ⚙️ Config
- Custom recipe  
- Toggle crafting  

### 🛠️ Command
/drillspawn <player>

---

## ⚙️ Config

- craftable_drill  
- recipe settings  
- particles  

---

## 🧠 Uses

- Survival  
- SMP  
- Mining servers  

---

## 💡 Info

Simple, fast, and configurable mining tool.

---
